title.en: The housing pressure behind the EU average
title.zh: 欧盟住房平均数背后的负担

summary.en: Eurostat’s November 26 housing publication reports a 19% average cost share for 2025, alongside a 36% share for the lower-income group. Different denominators explain why an average can conceal pressure.
summary.zh: 欧盟统计局11月26日发布住房数据：2025年住房成本平均占可支配收入19%，低收入组则为36%。读懂分母，才能看见平均数背后的压力。

title.en: Why twice the fruit could lose a place in space
title.zh: 结出两倍果实，为何仍未赢得太空席位

summary.en: NASA’s November 25 crop report describes progress with strawberries, cucumbers and lemon basil. A high-fruiting wild strawberry reveals the challenge: a future space menu must also fit its habitat.
summary.zh: NASA11月25日介绍草莓、黄瓜和柠檬罗勒的测试进展。一种结果更多的野草莓揭示了关键取舍：未来的太空餐桌，也须适应舱内空间。
